text:
Eleven audience ratings from 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-06 say the study page's transition cards are dense with firstmate-specific terms, repeat details from earlier sections, and get skimmed. The latest is 20261106-034035-50bm, citing card t8. Revise the transition card text in the study data the site renders. Give each card a one-sentence summary in plain words first. Define or link every firstmate term on first use, or replace it. Remove details already given in 'Start here' and replace them with a link back to that section. Keep every claim citation. Acceptance: (1) a test on the real study fails if a card uses a term that is neither in the glossary nor defined in the card; (2) every card still cites at least one claim, and the existing site tests pass; (3) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Readers keep flagging the study page's transition cards as dense with firstmate terms and repeating earlier sections
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
